bad.what_after: The safe-fetch module performs a fetch operation and validates robots and handles redirects and enforces size limits and checks content types and raises exceptions on failure which the caller then retries according to policy.

good.what_after:
safe-fetch is the gate in front of every outbound request.

It starts with robots, then walks redirects one hop at a time and re-checks each hop, because a public URL can bounce to a private one.

When a hop looks wrong it throws rather than following. The caller sees the failure and retries.
